acceptance.given: The Package A quality sidecar, standard, policy, and quality-contract schema are authored alongside the existing owner-specific Skill contract and Skill-input contract.

oracle.expected: The artifact and contract checks establish that the versioned quality sidecar has its own protocol role and coexists with both existing owner-specific protocols; neither existing protocol is repurposed, replaced, or changed.
forbidden: Repurposing, replacing, or changing the protocol of scripts/skill-contract.json.
Repurposing, replacing, or changing the protocol of references/skill-input-contract.v1.json.
oracle.observable: A bounded artifact check inspects the standard, quality-contract schema, and both existing contract files, and verifies the quality sidecar is additive while the existing files retain their owner-specific protocol roles.

acceptance.then: The artifact check can distinguish the additive quality-sidecar protocol from the unchanged owner-specific protocols.
acceptance.when: During the migration/compatibility artifact check, inspect the published standard and quality-contract schema together with the two existing protocol files; do not infer compatibility from validator return values alone.

failure_intents.selector_intent: scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_migration.py::test_a22 checks the authored standard and quality-contract schema against the existing owner-specific protocol artifacts; fail if coexistence is undocumented or either existing protocol is repurposed, replaced, or changed.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Define and document the quality sidecar as an additive, versioned protocol that coexists with the existing owner-specific Skill and Skill-input protocols.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No existing protocol or persisted state is migrated; removing the additive documentation/schema restores the prior artifact set.

slice_hint.state_transition: The quality sidecar protocol relation transitions from unspecified to explicitly additive, with both existing owner-specific protocol roles retained.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The migration artifact check verifies the standard and quality-contract schema describe the distinct quality-sidecar role and confirms both existing owner-specific protocol files remain present and unchanged in role.
